rationale: FX03 flagged cost_currency because the extracted unit was UNIT_STANDARD_USD_DASORC5G6KMGZ3CKZQSWFA rather than plain USD. Raw SOI evidence shows the relevant schedule columns are Amortized Cost and Fair Value in dollar-denominated presentation, and the currency footnote states amounts are denominated in U.S. Dollars unless otherwise noted. Targeted searches for Euro/EUR found only that generic footnote and no affected position, so the flagged USD-prefixed unit is a normalization/rule-scope false alarm rather than a real non-USD cost value.
